duplicate_control: No-change rows across all five positions are verified identical, not extra worlds. Chronological updates use distinct episode draws; this miniature has no duplicated product-of-factors arm.
execution_shift: Not the original V21 execution-shift world. Every no-change-to-role-change contrast is reported separately for each reader; no transfer claim.
limitations: Known finite channel and state vocabulary are shared by all readers; no law-marginal ceiling or trained direct model.
Direct chronological rival allows any different successor state; role mixture permits exactly one changed role. Different transition priors and capacity are explicit.

Static, all-fast and all-slow use declared reset rates 0, 1/8 and 1/64. Role/direct models use prior .25 no change, otherwise one uniformly located change in the 95 gaps. No true change time or role enters any reader.

32/96 histories are prefixes of the same 96-episode stream at the same absolute change position; matched fractional positions at different absolute times are distinct conditions. Future target episodes differ by horizon.
No-change rows repeat across positions and are duplicate controls, not independent evidence. All interventions share initial states and random draws; worlds, not streams, are uncertainty units.

The seven-bit target encodes current preference/skill/opportunity states, next opportunity, intention, execution success and artifact. This new miniature does not inherit old-world headroom or historical numbers.
No stable human values, learned change detection, execution-shift transfer, F03 category or fresh confirmation is established.
marginal_scoring: True-bit mass is log-sum-exp over saved joint log forecasts; never one minus rounded opposing mass.
